unrelated.note: Measured on the demo laptop webcam: dark navy quarter-zip jacket, 4 captures, sim 0.21-0.30. lowAnchor set at the top of that range so everyday outfits score ~0.

partial.note: Measured: dark ('rotten tomato') red top, 1 capture, sim 0.485 -> aura ~74. Colour right, no halter/bodice/gloves.

strong.note: Not measured yet (no full costume available). Set above the partial red-top match so a real recreation of the gown can reach 100. Re-measure with a costume and adjust.

notes: Game-design calibration anchors (spec §4), NOT a statistical accuracy claim. A raw similarity of 0.76 does not mean 76% costume accuracy. Set on 2026-10-31 with fashion-clip against cruella-ref-v3 from captures on the demo laptop webcam (upper-body framing): lowAnchor from an ordinary outfit, highAnchor chosen above a partial red-top match; the strong anchor is not yet measured. Requirement: highAnchor > lowAnchor. Recalibrate whenever the encoder, preprocessing, reference groups, camera or backdrop change.
